newsitem.title: UK: Clyde derides Gulf bid acceptances.
newsitem.headline: Clyde derides Gulf bid acceptances.

text.p: Bid target Clyde Petroleum Plc on Friday derided the level of acceptances predator Gulf Canada Resources had received for its bid and urged shareholders to continue to reject it.
In a statement, Clyde chairman Malcolm Gourlay described the 0.02 percent acceptances which Gulf said earlier on Friday that it had received so far as "inconsequential".
"Clyde has had an outstanding record since 1993 and we will be writing to shareholders again in due course with further information on our performance and future prospects," Gourlay said.
Gulf had earlier extended its 432 million pound ($726 million) hostile bid, launched in December last year, to 1500 GMT on January 24.
Today was the first closing date for its 105 pence per share offer.
Clyde shares closed on Friday unchanged at 116.5 pence.
